> **Adding or updating a single faculty member?** [Open an issue](https://github.com/nunojnunes/HCIRankings/issues/new/choose) using the faculty submission template — it's faster and validates your entry automatically!

## Required Checklist

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/nunojnunes/HCIRankings/blob/gh-pages/CONTRIBUTING.md) and check **all** boxes that apply.
Delete any lines that don't apply to your PR.

### Identity & Format
- [ ] My GitHub profile shows my full name
- [ ] PR title is descriptive (not "Update csrankings-x.csv")
- [ ] One PR per institution, all changes combined
- [ ] Only modified `csrankings-[a-z].csv` or `old/industry.csv`
- [ ] Did NOT use Excel
- [ ] No spaces after commas, no missing fields
- [ ] Entries in alphabetical order by full name

### Data Accuracy
- [ ] Name matches [DBLP](https://dblp.org) exactly (including 0001 suffixes)
- [ ] Homepage URL works and shows name + affiliation
- [ ] Google Scholar ID is the alphanumeric code only (not a full URL)

### Eligibility
- [ ] Faculty is full-time, tenure-track
- [ ] Can **solely** advise CS/HCI PhD students
- [ ] If not in CS/informatics department: included justification with links

### New Institutions
- [ ] If adding new institution: opened issue first to add it to `institutions.csv`
- [ ] Adding **all** HCI faculty at that institution (not just one)
